description: Android Fragment class 'HomeFragment' implementing the main home screen with top navigation bar, content sections, and mock data setup. Includes UI configuration for focus handling, accessibility, and styling.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main Fragment for the app's home screen, managing UI setup, mock data, and navigation configurations.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data class representing a piece of content with id, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row of content items with a title.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout using view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components such as brand text, top navigation, and content sections.

methods.name: setupBrand
methods.description: Configures the brand label with styled SpannableString and accessibility label.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Sets up the horizontal RecyclerView for categories including a search icon placeholder, with focus and key handling.

methods.name: setupSectionsList
methods.description: Builds and populates the main sections list with banners and content rows, configuring vertical RecyclerView.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Initializes mock data for content rails, configuring adapter and focus behavior.
